experiment: Task 2 Experiment 4 - Candidate Causal Feature Ablation
research_goal: Identify medically plausible, cross-environment stable candidate health features; predictive ablation is evidence about model reliance, not causal proof.
split: same held_out_split(seed=42, column=environment_region) for all conditions
preprocessing: feature-subset median imputation and StandardScaler; fit on source training rows only
full_feature_control: retrained in the same run for each region/model with the same seed and configuration as the corresponding ablation conditions

iadl_single.hypothesis: 功能状态/可能的结局近端信息
iadl_single.risk: 需检查IADL量表与认知结局是否存在测量构念重叠，以及IADL是否可能位于认知变化的下游路径。

depression_sleep.risk: 两变量可能受共同健康状态或未测量因素影响。

phone_use_bundle.hypothesis: 数字设备使用与生活方式信息
phone_use_bundle.risk: 手机使用可能同时反映年龄、教育、社会参与和环境条件。

socioeconomic_context.hypothesis: 社会经济与环境代理信息
socioeconomic_context.risk: 这些变量可能既包含真实社会决定因素，也包含样本构成/环境代理信息。

v5_sparsity_policy: Preserve historical sparsity='mean' and lambda_sparse; target_sparsity is inactive in mean mode, so no dimension-dependent retuning is introduced.

dictionary_matches.aliases_searched: IADL;日间功能障碍;工具性日常生活;日常生活能力;家务
if_use_mobile_phone;是否使用手机;使用手机
using_phone_year;手机使用年限;使用手机年限
hours_phone_per_day;每日手机使用;每天使用手机
education;受教育程度;教育程度;文化程度
wealth;财富状况;家庭财富;收入

limitations: One random seed is used to preserve comparability with historical LORO; repeat seeds are needed for robustness.
Ablation changes model input information and may alter optimization; paired same-seed controls reduce but do not eliminate this issue.
IADL may be outcome-proximal or share measurement constructs with cognition; dictionary and clinical review are required.
A performance decrease after ablation shows predictive reliance, not a causal effect.
Only three held-out regions and twelve monitoring sites are available.
